title: skill-override overrides file
description: Per-skill overrides keyed by the skill's name (the name field of SKILL.md frontmatter), applied on top of the original skill. Only description and autoinvoke may be overridden.

description.description: Replaces the skill description shown to the model. An empty string is applied as-is.

autoinvoke.description: false hides the skill from the model's advertised list; the skill stays registered and loadable by ID.
